# ResizeBank <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Banks](BlitzBasic-Banks)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ResizeBank:Void bank:Int32, size:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bank` | In | Int32 | required | The bank to resize. |
| `size` | In | Int32 | required | The new size in bytes. |

## Description

Changes the size of a bank. The start of the bank is kept, and when it grows the new part is filled with zeros.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
bank = CreateBank(4)
PokeInt bank, 0, 99
ResizeBank bank, 8
Print BankSize(bank)
Print PeekInt(bank, 0)
Print PeekInt(bank, 4)
FreeBank bank
```

```text
8
99
0
```
